text: Half of you didn't earn it. You just got lucky genes.
And the other half? Skipping meals isn't discipline.
It's just being hungry, and calling it a personality.
Skinny doesn't mean healthy. It just means skinny.
You can be thin and tired. Thin and weak. Thin and miserable.
Nobody gets a medal for a number on a scale.
Be strong. Be fed. Then we can talk.
Disagree? Say it in the comments.
